title: Prisoner of Ice: Jashin Kourin
native_title: プリズナー・オブ・アイス ～邪心降臨～
overview:
A battle unfolding in the Antarctic. A mysterious object sealed in a wooden crate.

- A Freezing Future -

The roar of the Old Ones. What is the truth beyond the wall of ice...

Solve a grand mystery spanning six chapters!!

It is January 1937. Lt. Ryan, a young American intelligence officer, is aboard the British submarine HMS Victoria as it escapes a secret German base in the Antarctic carrying two frozen crates. When depth charges damage the sub, something living breaks free.

This point-and-click adventure draws on H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu mythos. Guide Ryan through each scene, examine objects, talk to characters, collect items and use them in the right places to solve puzzles and push the story forward. Spoken dialogue is in English with Japanese subtitles.

- 1 player
- Shuttle Mouse compatible

南極で繰り広げられる攻防
木箱に封じ込められた謎の物体

―凍りつく未来―

古き者どもの咆哮
氷壁の向こうにある真実とは…

全6章からなる壮大な謎を解き明かせ！！
